Abcourt Mines Inc. is a Canadian gold company developing the Sleeping Giant mine and in exploration for its other properties strategically located in northwestern Quebec, Canada. Abcourt owns 100% of the Sleeping Giant mine and mill as well as the Flordin exploration property, where it focuses its operations.
